summary.en: Close on a search field, a query is typed; the camera pulls back as the other cards leave in reading order and the match floats into the first slot; a pointer clicks it and the camera pushes in.
summary.zh: 贴近搜索框打字；相机拉开，其余卡片按阅读顺序离场，目标卡浮到首位；光标点中它，相机推进交棒。

fits: A search or filter acted out at a human pace that narrows to one result and hands over into what the result opens.
notFor: Searches with several results; long queries; the last scene of a film.

intent.en: Let the viewer do it along with you: see what was typed, how the page answers, and where the click lands, at the pace of a human hand rather than a script.
intent.zh: 让观众“跟着做一遍”：看清输入了什么、页面怎么响应、点了哪里，节奏像人手，不像脚本。

content.en: A short query (en ≤ 14 chars, zh ≤ 5), 4–12 result cards with a title (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 6) and meta (en ≤ 12, zh ≤ 5), one of them the match; optional heading and placeholder (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 6); optionally a real page's layout.
content.zh: 一个短查询词（英文 ≤ 14 字符，中文 ≤ 5 字），4–12 张结果卡，每张一个标题（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 6）和元信息（英文 ≤ 12，中文 ≤ 5），其中一张是目标；可选页面标题和占位提示（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 6）；也可传入真实页面的布局。

fits.zh: 以人手的节奏演一次搜索或筛选，收敛到一个结果，并交棒进入这个结果打开的内容。

notFor.zh: 有多个结果的搜索；长查询；片子的最后一场。

pairs.note: what the clicked card opens: its fields filling in
the found item as the protagonist

en: Type at about 3 frames a character to start; first drafts of an interaction are almost always too fast.
The match must land in a real slot of the page; a card hovering above the grid reads as fake.
zh: 起稿按约 3 帧一个字打；交互镜头的初版几乎总是偏快。
目标卡要落进页面真实的槽位；悬在网格上方读作假。

upstream.summary: 真实 UI 上打字搜索、网格自己收敛成一张卡、点击穿透进详情页
upstream.use: 功能演示的"操作叙事"段；搜索/筛选/进入详情的任何交互链路
